datasets.label: Public source videos
datasets.count_basis: Actual video files present in the pinned repository inventory, including Extra subfolders.
notes: Counts measure the files currently present in this public mirror, not the original full INCLUDE dataset.
The source repository calls the validation folder val; the chart uses validation.
The three text manifests list 4,292 rows. 620 exact paths are absent from their listed split; seven videos stored in train are listed in the validation manifest. Charts count the 3,679 actual files.
Twenty-seven present videos live inside Extra subfolders and are included in these totals.
These public folder splits differ from the saved iPad assignments used by the demo; they do not establish signer independence.

datasets.label: Processed Apple Vision clips
datasets.count_basis: One unique video_id per current metadata/clips.jsonl row; exactly one category and one word label per clip.
notes: These are the current saved iPad splits, not the public video repository folder splits or a signer-disjoint evaluation.
There are 262 distinct word labels and 263 category-plus-word groups. The stored Tool-to-Clock correction retains the Home category, so Clock appears under both Home and Electronics.

The current stored metadata applies nine documented label corrections (eight train, one validation). The chart reads those stored labels; the corrections were not independently re-reviewed for this page update.
Compared with the demo-pinned base revision, all 4,257 clip IDs, frame counts and split assignments are unchanged; only those nine word labels differ.
The model demo intentionally retains its pinned base labels. This chart does not rewrite its frozen 720-clip evaluation.
Only aggregate counts are published here. Private clips, keypoints and model credentials remain on the server.

demo.label: Frozen Transformer validation cohort
notes: All 720 evaluation clips belong to the saved iPad validation split; 630 have a matched public source video and 90 do not.
The 630 matched public videos sit in 434 train, 48 validation and 148 test folders. These public folder assignments differ from the saved iPad validation assignments.
Epoch 102 was selected on this validation panel. Signer independence and held-out test performance are not established.
Nine later metadata label corrections are not applied to this pinned evaluation cohort.

cross_source_coverage.match_basis: Source category folder, cleaned source class folder, and filename; independent of corrected stored word label.
